_about: Public-domain Edward Hawkins (1789-1882), Provost of Oriel College, Oxford, for the Word Hoard: Discourses upon the Historical Scriptures of the Old Testament (1833), An Inquiry into the Connected Uses of the Principal Means of attaining Christian Truth, the Bampton Lectures (1840), Sermons on the Church (1847), Sermons on Scriptural Types and Sacraments (1851) and A Dissertation upon the Use and Importance of Unauthoritative Tradition (first 1819). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 83 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ehawkins-historical-scriptures: Discourses upon some of the principal objects and uses of the historical Scriptures of the Old Testament : preached before the University of Oxford (Oxford : J.H. Parker, 1833)
ehawkins-bampton-lectures: An inquiry into the connected uses of the principal means of attaining Christian truth : in eight sermons preached before the University of Oxford at the Bampton lecture for the year MDCCCXL (Oxford : John Henry Parker [etc.], 1840)
ehawkins-sermons-on-church: Sermons on the church, preached before the University of Oxford (London B. Fellowes and J.H. Parker, 1847)
ehawkins-types-and-sacraments: Sermons on Scriptural types and sacraments, preached before the University of Oxford : with observations upon some recent theories (London : B. Fellowes, 1851)
ehawkins-unauthoritative-tradition: A dissertation upon the use and importance of unauthoritative tradition (London : Society for Promoting Christian Knowledge ; New York : J.B. Young, 1889)
